mapper.select: select t.task_id, t.task_name, d.deliverable_id, d.deliverable_name, d.group_id, g.group_name, d.required_num, d.archived_num, d.deadline, d.status, (select count(1) from task_submission s where s.deliverable_id = d.deliverable_id and s.status = '1' and s.del_flag = '0') as pending_num from task_deliverable d inner join task_info t on t.task_id = d.task_id and t.del_flag = '0' inner join biz_research_group g on g.group_id = d.group_id and g.status = '0' and g.del_flag = '0' where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status != '3' and exists ( select 1 from biz_research_group_member active_member where active_member.group_id = d.group_id and active_member.user_id = #{userId} and active_member.status = '0' ) and ( exists ( select 1 from task_deliverable_user assigned where assigned.deliverable_id = d.deliverable_id and assigned.user_id = #{userId} ) or ( not exists ( select 1 from task_deliverable_user any_assignee where any_assignee.deliverable_id = d.deliverable_id ) and exists ( select 1 from biz_research_group_member privileged_member where privileged_member.group_id = d.group_id and privileged_member.user_id = #{userId} and privileged_member.status = '0' and privileged_member.member_role in ('LEADER', 'CORE') ) ) ) order by case when d.deadline is null then 1 else 0 end, d.deadline asc, d.group_id, t.task_id, d.sort, d.deliverable_id
